H2_calibration.quote: Agencies and courts may read the text purposively against the title, and sponsors will likely close visible gaps before or after enactment.

H1_holdback.quote: Pointing out loopholes in committee may prompt sponsors to tighten them. The vagueness, delegation, and workability items (8–11, 29, 35, 37, 41–43) are probably the strongest "unworkable as written" arguments without that risk.
